statement: ∀ (f : Fin n → Space n × ℝ → ℝ), (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f j) (timeDomain n)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => ∑ j, f j p) (timeDomain n)

exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => hf j)
